job.job_description:
Position: AI Engineer

Locations: Hyderabad, Pune, Greater Noida, Bangalore ( Not Remote Job )

Mode: Hybrid





Key Skills Required:

Python
Generative AI / Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
LangChain
LangGraph
OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, Milvus)
Agentic AI / AI Agents
Prompt Engineering
FastAPI / REST APIs
Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)

Job Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using LLMs and Generative AI technologies.
Build scalable RAG pipelines leveraging vector databases and knowledge retrieval frameworks.
Develop multi-agent workflows using LangGraph and LangChain.
Integrate OpenAI/Azure OpenAI models into enterprise applications.
Optimize prompts, model performance, and AI workflows for production environments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI-driven business solutions.

Preferred Experience:

3+ years of overall software development experience.
Hands-on experience in building and deploying GenAI/LLM applications.
Strong coding expertise in Python and API development.
Experience with cloud platforms and MLOps practices is preferred.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience, LangGraph workflows, FastAPI backend, AWS deployments, and transferable cloud skills.
